BLOCK — independent docs-site review of exact commit de9265cf584f2b27a1e45014549f279798c68792, base 76c62e738a2579d6598fccf3ac19266c60480e20.

BLOCKING FINDING: the code-heavy newcomer pages fail narrow-layout containment. At a 390x844 viewport, /method/represent-recall/ produced documentElement.scrollWidth 823 against clientWidth 390, a 433px page-level horizontal overflow. Its manual code element was about 790px wide; the parent PRE was 358px wide but had scrollWidth 806 and computed overflow-x visible. /method/build-interpretation/ overflowed by 752px and /scala/window-features/ by 559px. This is not an intentional code-local scroller: the entire page moves horizontally. The emitting sites are docs-site/src/content/docs/method/represent-recall.mdx:45,62; method/build-interpretation.mdx:44,48,66,68,91,93; scala/window-features.mdx:22,26. docs-site/src/styles/custom.css has no PRE containment rule.

REQUIRED REPAIR: contain these rendered code/output blocks within the content column, preferably through the standard Starlight or Expressive Code rendering path or one shared component; a narrowly verified fallback is max-width 100 percent plus overflow-x auto on the block and any required min-width zero on its containing grid. Add an executable browser regression at 390px which asserts documentElement.scrollWidth equals clientWidth on representative code-heavy pages, confirms code remains reachable via a block-local scroller where needed, and confirms the mobile menu opens. Rerun the exact docs verification and wide/narrow visual QA.

GREEN EVIDENCE, retained despite the block: isolated standalone clone at the exact SHA; diff restricted to docs-site. Exact grakern dependency clone at 0329c43c88a0b71e9aa4456723bb16bac2fa3841. npm ci passed with 434 packages and npm audit 0 vulnerabilities. STORYMODEL4S_GRAKERN_BUILD=/private/tmp/storymodel-astro-review.xj7PUL/grakern npm run verify exited 0; log SHA-256 6936ceeb6a788e92a855b7195048817d80245a5bed1aad6d6be1c74e90216579. It verified all 13 manifested Scala programs by exact stdout, Astro check 21 files with 0 errors, 0 warnings, 0 hints, static build 21 pages, navigation 20 built pages and 19 unique sidebar entries, provenance and dirty/mismatched-revision courts, figure mutation courts, and byte-identical 1726-byte verbatim recall evidence with SHA-256 62f03a03ed09c4fe4beeeb3ec5b0b4d8fe34bac0c411983a41e7101621582ba1. Landing at desktop and mobile had zero page overflow; the mobile menu opened and exposed Orientation. Browser lifecycle guard was clean before and after; preview port 4322 was stopped.

Content review found the newcomer path, public/internal surface separation, pre-release and platform caveats, segmentation and interpretation uncertainty, exact source links, module inventory, and example manifest coverage substantively honest. The sole Astro build warning is that sitemap generation is skipped because site is unset; not the reason for this block.

Scope ceiling: read-only candidate review. No source, ref, index, reservation, bead, authorization, landing, or publication change. External web links were inspected as authored targets but not live-availability audited.
